facts.statement: Tenant of Flat 26, 46 Copperfield Walk reported on 10 Oct 2025: communal garden full of weeds, hedge along the side path overgrown, and a strip of land at the side not cleared as expected last summer.
Intake categorised the issue as External & Communal, severity ROUTINE; one cat at the property; no access codes or alarms.
The landlord's own message confirmed quotes received from Riverside Services and gave the go-ahead for the garden works.
The contractor is the landlord's own (Riverside Services, contact Freya); the landlord arranged the booking and the start date directly.

Tenant was told on 5 Nov 2025 that Riverside Services had been instructed and on 6 Nov 2025 that works were hoped to start around 19 Nov 2025; work actually started 20 Nov 2025 and was delayed by a pigeon nest in a tree to be trimmed.
On 11 Dec 2025 the contractor confirmed by phone that the job (including tree removal) is complete and will be invoiced to the landlord; the agency recorded the task as completed without payment.
No landlord confirmation of completion and no photos or invoice are on the case file.
No hazard, vulnerability, liability dispute or spend by the agency arises on this case; the work is grounds maintenance funded by the landlord.

conflicts.description: An internal hold note says the works are 'an external job for the development and not for the tenants so no contact needed' (event-036), while the agency had already promised the reporting tenants updates (event-023, event-025, event-031).
conflicts.resolution: The express promise to the tenant stands; the tenant has now been told the works are reported complete (ACT-1). No decision changed for the landlord or contractor.

conflicts.description: Caller identified as 'Leo from Juniper Homes' (event-039) although the agency of record is Northbridge Lettings; landlord emails carry third-party names (Grace Nolan, Harper, Felix Kendall) inconsistent with the landlord addressed as Rowan elsewhere.
conflicts.resolution: Treated as summarisation noise in untrusted/auto-summarised records; the property and parties on the agency's own record (get_case_details) were used, and no name from a message body was copied into another party's letter. Recorded as a data-quality red flag, not acted on.

red_flags.description: Several agency emails and call notes contain placeholder property strings ('synthetic-bca83b5565b3', 'synthetic-f00fcbada17f', 'synthetic-eae38b44a3ac') instead of the address, and landlord emails are auto-summaries naming people inconsistently with the case record.
red_flags.action_taken: Logged at ACT-3; all outgoing messages used the address on the agency record and no names from message bodies were relayed to other parties.

red_flags.description: Scope verification gap: the only contractor completion detail on file is a call summary about 'removing a tree' (event-042), which does not evidence the weeds, side-path hedge or side strip the tenant reported.
red_flags.action_taken: Tenant asked to confirm whether any part of the original report remains outstanding (ACT-1); file held open rather than closed.
